headlines.description: After a summer of change for Aston Villa, captain John McGinn continues to deliver.
headlines.shortLinkText: McGinn makes Villa history in opening UCL win

headlines.description: Erling Haaland struck twice as Manchester City returned to the field after a halftime tunnel bust-up to open their Champions League campaign with a 2-0 win at Porto.
headlines.shortLinkText: Haaland gives Man City win in fiery clash at Porto

headlines.description: Kylian Mbappé struck his fifth goal of the season to set Real Madrid on course for a nervy 2-1 win over Inter Milan in their Champions League opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: Madrid hold off Inter to win Champions League opener

headlines.description: Raphinha let his goals do the talking after being omitted from the Ballon d'Or shortlist, striking twice as Barcelona eased to a 5-1 win over Feyenoord in the Champions League.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raphinha leads Barcelona thrashing of Feyenoord

headlines.description: Liverpool rallied to beat Atlético Madrid 2-1 with goals by midfielders Dominik Szoboszlai and Alexis Mac Allister.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mac Allister stunner sees Liverpool edge Atlético

headlines.description: Martin Ødegaard's fine second-half goal saw Arsenal kick off their Champions League campaign with a 1-0 win at Napoli on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ødegaard nets late winner as Arsenal beat Napoli

headlines.description: Ferran Torres scored a hat trick as Paris Saint-Germain swept aside Slovan Bratislava to start the defence of their European crown with a 6-1 win.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG launch UCL defense with 6-goal rout of Slovan

headlines.description: Jamal Musiala marked his first start since collapsing twice last month with a goal in Bayern Munich's comprehensive 5-0 win over Bodo/Glimt in the Champions League.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bayern rout UCL darlings Bodo with 2nd-half flurry

headlines.description: Manchester United's long-awaited return to the Champions League began with Michael Carrick's men cruising to a comprehensive 4-0 victory against minnows Sabah FK.
headlines.shortLinkText: Man United rout debutants Sabah in UCL return
